UmpMessageType.description: UMP Message Type nibble: 0=Utility,1=System,2=MIDI1 Ch Voice,3=SysEx7,4=MIDI2 Ch Voice,5=SysEx8/MDS,13=Flex,15=Stream.

x-midi-spec.section: UMP message types and packet sizes

Group.description: MIDI Group (0-15). Utility (0x0) and Stream (0xF) are groupless in v1.1+; set 0.

UmpHeader64.description: 64-bit UMP header for MIDI 2.0 Channel Voice.

UmpHeader128.description: 128-bit UMP header for Data (SysEx8/MDS) and Flex Data.

Midi1ChannelVoiceBody.description: Messages share this body, with relevant fields set based on status.

SysEx7Body.description: 7-bit clean stream framed in 32-bit UMP words (up to 6 bytes per word).

Midi2ChannelVoiceBody.description: Only fields relevant to the specific status are present.

mds.description: Mixed Data Set chunking for large transfers

staticFunctionBlocks.description: S bit; when true Function Blocks are static and do not change after discovery (Figure 13, M2-104-UM v1.1.2 p.33)

numberOfFunctionBlocks.description: Number of Function Blocks (0x00 = none, 0x01–0x20 = count, 0x21–0x7F reserved) (Figure 13, p.33)

manufacturerId.description: SysEx manufacturer ID (1-byte or 3-byte, pad with zeros when 1-byte) (Figure 14, M2-104-UM v1.1.2 p.34)

name.description: UTF-8 endpoint name; up to 98 bytes across Complete/Start/Continue/End forms (Figure 15, M2-104-UM v1.1.2 p.35)

productInstanceId.description: ASCII 0x20–0x7E Product Instance Id, up to 42 bytes across Complete/Start/Continue/End forms (Figure 16, M2-104-UM v1.1.2 p.35)

jrTimestampsTx.description: JR Transmit requested; if unsupported, receiver should send Stream Config Notification to switch protocol without JR (Section 7.2.2.3)

jrTimestampsRx.description: JR Receive requested; if unsupported, receiver should send Stream Config Notification to switch protocol without JR (Section 7.2.2.3)

active.description: Function Block active flag (Figure 22, M2-104-UM v1.1.2 p.40)

midi1Bandwidth.description: MIDI 1.0 bandwidth: 0=not MIDI1, 1=do not restrict, 2=restrict to 31.25 kbps (Figure 22, p.40)

StreamBody.description: Endpoint discovery, protocol selection, and FB info.

DeltaClockstampConfig.description: Clip configuration timing as used in MIDI Clip Files.

details.description: Profile Details / Reports (e.g., channel mask bits cmL/cmH, ok flags)

subscriptionId.description: Subscription identifier used in PE subscription flows (e.g., sub3221)

flowControl.description: Flow Control flag for Inquiry: Get Property Data (Table 13, M2-103-UM v1.2 p.28)

status.description: Reply status (HTTP-like codes per Table 15, M2-103-UM v1.2 p.29)

cacheTime.description: Seconds the document may be cached

mediaType.description: MIME type for non-JSON Property Data (Table 16, M2-103-UM v1.2 p.31)

data.description: JSON or encoded non-JSON; when JSON, schema may be referenced via header.schema

statusCodes.description: Property Exchange reply status codes (Table 15) or notify-only codes (Table 16 timeout wait via ACK)

timeoutStatus.description: Deprecated Notify timeout status codes (100, 408) for backward compatibility per M2-103-UM v1.2 p.49

flowControlError.description: Status to return when flowControl is requested but unsupported (406/407 per M2-103-UM v1.2 p.69–71)

deltaClockstampTicksPerQuarterNote.description: DCTPQ for Delta Clockstamp timing (0 reserved; Figure 33, M2-104-UM v1.1.2 p.45)

cacheTime.description: Seconds the Property Data may be cached (Section 7.4.3, M2-103-UM v1.2 p.30–31)

flowControlAck.description: MIDI-CI ACK flow control message (Table 94, M2-103-UM v1.2 p.69)

chunkNumber.description: Chunk number (LSB first) in flow-control ACK

messageLength.description: Length of the message (0 when no message; reserved otherwise)

flowControlNak.description: MIDI-CI NAK flow control retransmit request (Table 97, M2-103-UM v1.2 p.72)

subscriptionCommand.description: Subscription command values per M2-103-UM v1.2 subscription flows

deviceId.description: Device ID for message report scope: 0x00–0x0F channel 1–16, 0x7E group, 0x7F function block (Table 43/45, M2-101-UM v1.2 p.61–63)

messageDataControl.description: Message Data Control (Table 44, M2-101-UM v1.2 p.62): 0x00 begin/end only, 0x01 non-default/active only, 0x7F full report; 0x02–0x7E reserved.

systemMessages.description: Bitmap of requested System Messages (Table 43/45, M2-101-UM v1.2 p.61–63)

channelControllerMessages.description: Bitmap of requested Channel Controller Messages (Table 43/45, M2-101-UM v1.2 p.61–63)

noteDataMessages.description: Bitmap of requested Note Data Messages (Table 43/45, M2-101-UM v1.2 p.61–63)

supportedFeatures.description: Process Inquiry Supported Features bitmap (Table 42, M2-101-UM v1.2 p.60)
